steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: How did they make this...?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It has the toughness of Goss Harag Fur, but is as light as Nargacuga Scales...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: And that goes fur the other clothing too, the consistency in quality is meowtstanding!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The strangest thing is pawssibly that... everyone has clothes with tailoring meowch better than what you can get from the best Smithies.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: There's simply no way this area has enough meownsters to provide this much material though...?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: New meowterials! I like them so meowch! And even more in the forest!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: We should lend that long-horned Hunter a paw with the Rathalos!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Purr-haps you might want to rethink that, Smithy! This locale and the New World we were headed to are two completely diffurent places.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The villagers here don't go into the forest to hunt, or craft weapons and armor with meownster materials...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: There's so meowch stuff in this village I've never seen befur, and I have no clue where they came from or how they work.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Though based on what Yato said, some of them seem to be observing the endemic life here, like the members of the Elder Dragon Observation Team or the Ecological Research Center...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But it's still so diffurent in so meowny aspects!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Diffurent?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Pawsitively! We must figure out a way back as soon as pawssible; I still have a chance to be the purr-ime Ecological Researcher of the New World!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Isn't this a New World too...?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy! Are you saying... this is simply yet another undiscovered New World? More impurr-tantly, one that no other Commission has been to befur?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No Hunters or Researchers! None of those Elder Dragon Observation Team louts! A totally diffurent, brand new world that only we know of!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: If I can make ampaw recordings of our observations and findings here... I'll be basking in the limelight as a star scholar when we get back!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Those Wyverians buried in their books will be so stunned by my newfound gnawledge—I'm purr-ty clever if I do say so myself!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No, that's not it... I have to think this over carefully.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: We're not the sort to just follow the Hunters all day, and we've already helped them deal with the Rathalos once!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Rathalos! Bang bang!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I won't prevent mew from going if you really want to, Smithy. I'm just going to wait here and see...

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: Whoa! Look, guys! Are they Felines?

steps.name: Older Child
steps.text: How could they be Felines when they're this tiny? And so fluffy too... how cute!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Hey! What are mew doing!

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: Whoa, it can speak too! That's so adorable!

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: Can you play with us, little Feline?

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: We can carry you and give you pretty clothes to wear.

steps.name: Curious Child
steps.text: Or throw you in the air! And catch you! Just like that!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Prepawsterous... you sharp-eared cravens, I hail from the Royal Pawleontology Scriveners and am not your plaything!

steps.name: Older Child
steps.text: Let's try giving it some headpats.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Hey! Get your paws off me! I'm warning mew...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ah... it's so comfurtable...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No, I can't!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy...come back...wait fur me!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I've decided, yes!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Since they've made such a sincere request to use my purrfound expurrtise to deal with the Rathalos...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: As a former Royal Pawleontology Scrivener, my purrfessionalism would never allow me to refuse to lend a paw!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Let us be off, posthaste!

steps.name: Roka Village Headman
steps.text: Oh, so you're saying... you came upon a monster the size of a house in the forest near our village? And that it can fly and breathe fire in all directions, and even has venomous claws...

steps.name: Roka Village Headman
steps.text: Haha, the forest is truly a wonder.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I understand that you may find that hard to believe, but we saw it with our own eyes. We even fought it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: While I can't confirm that this will escalate into some new kind of crisis, I suggest we immediately notify all the villagers and start evacuating as per standard Catastrophe measures.

steps.name: Roka Village Headman
steps.text: How unfortunate for you to come all this way, only to run into such a troubling matter.

steps.name: Roka Village Headman
steps.text: I am called Ataru Takii, the headman of this little Roka village. The peace we enjoy here stems not from me alone, but is thanks to all of our efforts.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Please, have a taste of this tea.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: It's a local specialty of ours, and not only is it refreshing, it can also help speed up recovery.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Don't mind if I do.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Takii, we don't have the luxury of time here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...I'll take a sip later.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Did you not understand what I said? Only by swiftly evacuating the villagers can we ensure their safety and handle the crisis without any worries.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ah, youth are always in such a rush, but that's not a bad thing. As the saying goes, the early fowlbeast gets the worm.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Please have a seat, you two. We still have time to discuss this in more detail.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, why not hear him out first?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I hope you will carefully consider our proposal and, if conditions permit, fortify the village defenses to ensure everyone is safe during the evacuation.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You mentioned this before, but from where did you come from again? Rho-something...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ah, yes. Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You must be Operators Yato and Noir Corne, yes? If memory serves me right.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Let me try to recall why I contacted you people back then... Oh yes, you claim to be able to treat Oripathy?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Recently, several families in Roka seem to have gotten infected.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The Shimanaga, Watazawa, Senno, and Ishidori households... the last one in particular has an especially young child who's contracted Oripathy, and it is heartbreaking to see.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We are well versed in handling everything related to Oripathy, so you can leave that matter to us.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Of course, and thank you very much for coming, but there remains another small issue nagging at me.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I just can't wrap my head around it, why are you so concerned with the monsters in the forest?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Are you not a pharmaceutical company?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let me explain. Regional outbreaks of Oripathy often have an underlying cause, and the best way to effectively deal with it is to eliminate the source of Originium dust.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: To be honest, we investigated the mountains earlier and found some clues linking the outbreak to that creature.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Although we can't conclusively prove it yet, prevention is always better than cure.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I see, I see. How meticulous; I'd expect no less of Rhodes Island. I do hope the village youths can learn a thing or two from you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I must still insist that you heed our advice to ensure the safety of everyone in the village.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ah, yes. I still have one more question for the both of you though.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Please, go ahead.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: ...How did you find the tea?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Please don't try to change the subject—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's pretty good, tasty and invigorating. Way better than the mass-produced bottled stuff you find in bars.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Oh yes, those Mitsumoto bigshots also like it very much.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So you do business with the Mitsumotos...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: We use a very expensive herb called Suzuka to make this blend of tea. It grows near the Soubo mountain range and nowhere else.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: All the Suzuka tea produced in all of Higashi comes from this tiny region you find yourselves in.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Besides that, we also specialize in handcrafted ironwork and ornamental woodcrafts, thanks to the high quality ores and variety of trees we have around here.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you getting at?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: To put it bluntly, only a few years back we were but a tiny hunting village, and our livelihood depended on how well the hunt went.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: We would sing and dance around the campfire when the woods were bountiful, but there were also times when we could count the days our rations would last on one hand, not to mention the ever-present worry of being attacked by beasts at night.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: But these last few years, we've been able to replace our thatched rooves with wood, light up our streets at night, and our children are able to enjoy hot baths every day.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Now, nobody has to go hunting in the mountains, nor worry about tomorrow.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: So to leave our homes over some vague hunch you have... the villagers won't readily accept it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I have no intention of making this permanent. Once the situation has been taken care of, you should be able to return.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: And how many days would that take? One? Two? Maybe a month? A year? Can you ensure the village stays intact? That we will be able to return to the lives we have now?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Can Rhodes Island guarantee that?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: As of right now... I'm afraid not. We can't predict the exact scale of the situation, but—

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Of course you can't, which is why we won't leave.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: How is the villagers' safety not your top priority?! I can guarantee you that this thing exists, so how can we simply ignore the threat of such a large and dangerous creature?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Are you absolutely sure?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Of what?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: We have a saying here: when you see butterflies fluttering in fall, in truth they are but falling leaves.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: We are all too familiar with this forest, Ms. Yato, so perhaps what you think you saw was simply that.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We'll go do checkups on the village's Infected, and then arrange a treatment plan based on our findings.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Thank you both, really. But now that you bring up treatment plans... I do have one more small favor to ask of you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We're listening.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Could you possibly provide us with some Oripathy-suppressing drugs right now?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What for...?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: This situation really worries me to no end, even with the two of you here. So just in case a similar outbreak occurs again in the future, I would like us to at least have some medication ready.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Please rest assured, I intend to pay in full for everything.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's no need for that, we'll just handle the source of the—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Will it be a bother?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No... there's no problem, we can give you some right away.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh yeah, Headman Takii. I still have a question... You said the village used to make a living through hunting, so are there any hunters still around?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: With no need to hunt, naturally we have no hunters.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: 'Cause I met someone earlier, when we just got here, who looked an awful lot like a hunter. I think he said his name was Kashiwau, do you know who that is?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: A hunter? Ha, in truth even I could call myself a hunter.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: He's pretty old, so he tends to run his mouth. He likes to go to the mountains and swing sticks at trees.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: But... his eccentric personality might cause you some trouble in future, so I think it would be best to stay away from him.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He doesn't seem to have any family around either, did he get into some kinda trouble?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You ask interesting questions. He's just the reclusive sort. Every village has one or two of them, it's nothing unusual.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: It's getting late, so why not call it a day here? I wish you both a pleasant stay in our humble abode.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Sorry to bother you.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ah...right. Just a piece of friendly advice.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Seasoned hunters all know this: the more curious the forest beast, the more easily it falls into a trap.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Do keep that in mind.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I can only blame myself for underestimating the village's reluctance to evacuate.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It was unwise to try to get them to leave with only the suspicion of danger and no hard evidence.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I think... even if we brought evidence, he still wouldn't believe us that easily.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: He's been refusing to hear us out, and even wants us to stay away from the Rathalos.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Did you stop me earlier because of the way he was acting?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Well, his reason for wanting the drugs was sort of unusual and more than a little fishy, so I figured it'd be faster to just agree and then see what he does.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: As for his parting words... It's hard to see them as anything but a warning.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don’t care.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Regardless of the attitude of the people here, we have only one duty: to protect them from any threat.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Needless to say, I will find a solution.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: As for you, you care too much.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I just... I just thought Kashiwau was acting a bit too oddly.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I understand your concern, but it has nothing to do with our mission.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Don't waste your energy on irrelevant things.

a.text: Ice-cold, on an autumn night in the mountains.
The wind blew through the still-warm body.
It had been bitten, torn apart, chewed on.

steps.text: Kill them!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Aaaagh—

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Kusso... Just a dream.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I saw you again in it...

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Mr. Kashiwau, are you there?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Come in...

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I brought some onigiri and boiled bamboo shoots, I'll just leave them on the table, okay?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I also got some bento boxes from the city, so you can just warm them up and—oh, are you heading out?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Yes, I'm going up the mountain.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Are, are you going to deal with that... oversized flying monster those two operators were talking about?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm just going on a regular hunt.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Then... can I just say... I've been preparing for this day, and now that a super powerful monster has appeared, it's time I finally became a proper hunter.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Look, I have a bow, leather hiking boots, and a knife. I'm healthy and pretty strong.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: So... can I come hunting with you?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: What... can't you at least think it over?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I can help you with a lot of things, like carrying your hunting spear, setting up traps, carrying pelts down the mountain...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You're too young for that, kid. With no experience, you'll only slow me down.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I'm not a kid anymore! Back in the day, children my age would already be out hunting, there's no way you don't know that.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: I'll be good and stay out of trouble!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That's enough from you.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Everyone says... there are no more hunters in the village....*sob*

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Hunters defeat the beasts in the forest, and are the strongest heroes of the village, like you.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: It's obvious that you've been protecting everyone the whole time, so why do they talk about you like that?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: They even say you're not a real hunter, just a doddering old man who goes up the mountain to get his bones chewed on by beasts...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: They said...*sigh*

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The forest... becomes more dangerous by the day.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It's no longer safe for anyone to set foot in.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: They... They were lying, right Mr. Kashiwau? You're a real hunter, right?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'll take care of that monster and return. Believe me.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Alright, enough crying.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Though it may be too early for you now, I still believe that one day you'll be a real hunter.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This is a promise between the two of us, alright?

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Yeah... promise.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Huh? Why are all the villagers coming out?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Raise your hands, yes, like that.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Don't be afraid, I'm just taking a quick look.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Alright, good girl.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Next please.
The old hunter lingered for a moment, and was about to turn away.
Then the young operator happened to glance sideways, and they met eyes for an instant.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Can I ask... how's my health? I've been getting a lot of headaches lately.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Don't worry, it's nothing serious.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Here are some painkillers. No need to take one daily, just whenever you feel severe pain.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, you should come check out the angiography results.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Alright... please wait a moment, I'll be back right away for the rest of the consultation.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Do you see this?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: How could this be...?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting, but I have a question to ask.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Actually, there have been some slight changes detected in your condition. Have you encountered anything unusual lately? Or visited any places you don't normally go?

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Ah! Is... Is it serious?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Not for now, but if you continue to be exposed to active Originium and develop Oripathy, dealing with the consequences won't be easy.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It doesn't even have to be recently, but please try and recall if you've had any unusual encounters, especially with Originium.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Active Originium...? But how? They said I was properly protected when I went in.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Went in? Where?

steps.name: Strict Villager
steps.text: Narumatsu! Don't say things that will make the doctor misunderstand.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: I, I'm just a blacksmith... how could I possibly have been exposed to Originium, there must be some sort of mistake.

steps.name: Strict Villager
steps.text: Indeed, our village is fairly disciplined, so there shouldn't be any cause for concern here, Doctor.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...I understand. Please be careful to stay away from areas that might be contaminated with active Originium, and not to touch any suspicious objects in the future.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That was the last one.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Find out anything new?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: They've all been saying the same things, either that they never leave the village or nothing at all.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Using the possibility of contracting Oripathy as a scare tactic hasn't been effective. The moment you ask about anything other than their condition, or ask where they've been, they immediately put up their guard.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Although only a few individuals were diagnosed with acute Oripathy and were instructed on how to properly deal with it, we cannot underestimate the extent to which Oripathy has affected the village as a whole.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The results you showed me earlier... Were the rest of them similar?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If they haven't been in contact with Originium recently, then where did the outbreak come from?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: According to the angiogram results, the villagers have been exposed to active Originium for at least a few years.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Only in trace amounts, though, resulting in vague symptoms and only a few that have actually contracted Oripathy.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It's due to limited exposure to an extremely low concentration of Originium particles, I think.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Was it at the same level we detected in the Rathalos's scratch marks?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No... that was high enough to induce Oripathy outright and is probably related to the few villagers who did contract the disease. They also mentioned they went into the forest.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Breathes deeply)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Let's see. If this area has been under continuous exposure to Originium, and then one day it suddenly spiked, could it be that...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Both sources of Originium... come from the same place?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Very likely.

steps.name: Strict Villager
steps.text: Hello there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You're from earlier.

steps.name: Strict Villager
steps.text: Excuse me, I should have introduced myself. I am called Hiroshi Ritou, and my family has lived here for many generations.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hello. Do you need something from us?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: I hope the two of you can forgive me for interrupting your inquiry earlier, I was simply worried that he had misspoken in public, which could have consequences.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Consequences? What do you mean?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Ah, because of a certain matter in this village... many people have dirty laundry they'd rather not air.

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Y-You two! Are you the visiting doctors?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Um... we can only examine for Oripathy.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: What's got you in such a hurry?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Ah, could it be...?

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Please! You have to save the Ishidoris' boy!

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: I'm his neighbor, and he's really sick... He keeps on vomiting blood.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Vomiting blood?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That sounds serious, we'd better get going.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: I'll come with you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Pass the drainage tube.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Pliers! Quickly!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Gauze!

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *cough*... *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Phew—we succeeded. Luckily, we've dealt with a similar situation before.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, I remember that. Back then, you were doing it to yourself...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I take it your idle chatter means you need more to do? Go give him a suppressant shot.

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Doctor... will he be okay?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: He's out of danger.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There was bleeding in his lungs, and being in the wrong posture caused a blood clot to clog up his airways... Make sure he sits up properly and gets ample rest.

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Thank goodness.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's too early to breathe easy, things aren't looking very well for him.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: His infection has been the most severe we've seen so far here, though fortunately he got a suppressant shot just in time.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But that will only slow the symptoms, and will have to be followed up with more shots. He might even need to be brought back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But to be in this condition... what exactly did he come into contact with?

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: I don't know, there shouldn't have been anything...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That doesn't make sense. What about his family?

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: I don't know either...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What exactly are you all hiding?

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *sleep talking* Papa...

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *sleep talking* Papa, would... never lie...

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *sleep talking* Monster... Giant monster...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A monster?

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: You can't say that!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ahhh! Miss, please don't get any closer!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne, keep her in check.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: My throat... water...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Here you go—careful, drink it slowly.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *gulping*

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm here to help, so don't be afraid.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Where's your family?

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Papa, he... got taken away by the village headman soon after he came back from the cave.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What cave?

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Child! You mustn't speak of that to outsiders! This only concerns—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Shut up! Can it be any more important than a child's life?

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Papa... He would go into the cave every morning, and come back late at night.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: But yesterday... *cough*... there was a loud noise from the cave.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: The village headman said... he needed people to take a look... So Papa went in, and got a fever when he came back... and had rocks growing on him.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Oripathy worsens rapidly.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Sounds like he might have come into direct contact with active Originium and gotten some of it on his body, causing the boy's condition to deteriorate too.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Papa said, there are big monsters in the cave and it's not safe... but the village headman said he was lying, so nobody believed him... and then he got taken away.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: He would never lie... never...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There, there. He wasn't lying. We... saw a monster with our own eyes.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Really...?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes, but don't worry. We're very strong, and won't let the monster harm the village.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Can you defeat it, lady...? And protect the village... Papa didn't lie...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mm... I give you my word. As captain of Rhodes Island Op Team A4, I, Operator Yato, accept your commission.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And I never break my promises.

steps.name: Infected Child
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Now that's enough talking, you need to get some more rest, okay?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Step aside, Corne.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You... You should have seen that kid's condition earlier, right?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Many of the villagers have been infected, and if the source of the Originium dust isn't taken care of, you will all contract Oripathy, and things will only get worse from there.

spans.text: Many of the villagers have been infected, and if the source of the Originium dust isn't taken care of, you will
contract Oripathy, and things will only get worse from there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The next person to end up like this will be you! Am I clear?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So tell me what exactly it is you're all hiding!

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Sorry, I can't...

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Let her go, she had no choice. Perhaps it's better that I explain.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Please leave, I'll talk to them.

steps.name: Anxious Villager
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Finally talking?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: The cave the boy mentioned... It's in the mountain behind the village. Many villagers work down there under the village headman.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What's inside?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: I don't work there, so I don't know. And even if I did know, I wouldn't be able to talk about it, just like she couldn't.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So the village headman is the one making sure everyone keeps their mouths shut?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Well, I didn't say that.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Please take care of the child. In the meantime, I'll go clarify matters with the headman.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Wait, are you sure about that?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If the situation isn't resolved, the village will only be in more danger!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: And do you really think he'll tell you the truth? You'll only get ambiguous answers and end up even further from a solution.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He's right, Yato.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: I know where it is.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This is the place he mentioned, and I already scouted out the area. There aren't many houses on this side of the village, and the terrain is pretty wack, so that doesn't seem suspicious at first glance.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Over there, there are two villagers chatting like they're just taking a break out behind the mountain.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: But it's obvious that they keep glancing at that one house over there.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll take them down, and you go take a look inside.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait, what if we mess this up?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Knock out two innocent villagers and they'll definitely kick us out of the village.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy here has an idea fur mew!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Whoa, where did you guys come from?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: We've decided to come help mew two with the Rathalos, so you should be on your hindpaws thanking us fur the assistance!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So you think you can lure them away?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I don't think anything, Smithy's the one with the idea.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, let's leave it to them, and the both of us can sneak in from the back.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy... Is this idea of yours really going to work?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: And where did all these ingredients come from?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Chop! Stir! No stopping meow!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ahhh, how appawlling!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I, a furmer Royal Pawleontology Scrivener, destined to be the most amazing researcher of the New World...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Am not some ordinary canteen chef!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Turn it over! It's done! Well done!

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Is it time for dinner yet?

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: What are you talking about? The sun hasn't even set yet.

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: I didn't have breakfast or lunch today, not even a snack...

spans.text: lunch today, not even a snack...

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Ever since those two outsiders arrived, the headman stationed me here to keep an eye out, so I haven't had the chance to get a bite.

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: I'm so hungry...

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: Can you keep a lid on it? You're not the only one who's hungry here.

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Hey, do you think those two will really come looking? Haven't they been busy treating the villagers?

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: Just follow the headman's orders and stay put.

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: Do you want what happened with that girl to happen again? She turned the village upside down back then.

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Fine, fine, I'll hold it in.

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Wait, what's that smell?

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: Smell? What smell—Ah!

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Perfectly roasted meat, melted grease bubbling over the vegetables, and the sweet scent of roasted fruit... I've never smelled anything like it before!

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: (*salivating*)

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: Just stop talking, I can smell it too, you know...

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: C'mon, let's take a look, maybe someone's brought us food.

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: You go. I'll wait here.

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Are you sure? Didn't you say you were hungry too?

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: ...Just a quick look.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrrow! A nutritious and energizing meal pawmade by Felynes, purrfect fur dinner!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: A table fur two, purrhaps?

steps.name: Strong Villager
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Starving Villager
steps.text: Ah, they're—

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy! We have customeows!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Okay! I'm... I'm standing still, right here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Be gentler when you step on m—ouch!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is this the cave the kid was talking about?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It doesn't seem natural. There are signs of excavation work all along the walls.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: They even laid tracks on the ground... These prints look pretty fresh too, so they must have used it recently.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The entrance to the cave was sealed when we came in, and it didn't look like they closed it for us... but to keep something in.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Given what the Ishidori kid said, there was probably an accident here recently... Do you think the tracks might lead us closer to the Rathalos?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We'll know once we go deeper in.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What's that up ahead?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Wait, don't move!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'll go take a looksee.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Slow down, you... Be careful.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No problemo, it doesn't seem to be alive.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Burnt clothing... Looks like it was taken off before it caught fire.

spans.text: Burnt clothing... Looks like it was taken off

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's more over there.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: A helmet and portable flashlight... Maybe that kid's dad left it here.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's a ventilation shaft just up ahead. He probably left his things here and tried to escape through the shaft but failed.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So he was running away, and probably really nervous.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: This hole is big enough to house a Rathalos, so most likely...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne, go test the burnt clothes.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I've got the results. There's traces of active Originium, in a similar concentration to the sample we got from the scratch marks in the forest, but slightly higher.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Do you smell anything strange, Yato?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Blood, from up ahead.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'll go take a looksee.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: This is... a piece of meat?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Huge chunks of meatbeast, and fresh too. Probably left here shortly before we came in.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Seems like they dragged it down here, but why?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Maybe to attract some kind of carnivore? Ah...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Attract... the Rathalos!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mraaa!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Mwaagh!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mraaaahh!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Stupid long-horned Hunter! What are mew shouting for!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Because you guys just jumped out without any warning!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah... that particular smell again...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: We purrfectly distracted those guards and there was so meowch left over!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: We knocked them out cold!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: So it ended up like the original plan anyway... Wait, leftover what?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Don't mew mind it... just keep going!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We'll be here for a bit, there's a lot of investigating to do.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: They're going to catch up with mew.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh... what's going to catch up?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: People.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Why would there be people down here?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Is it not purrfectly normal for people to try and catch mew if you sneak into their place?!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Even if Smithy didn't pilfur their kitchens, mew would have been discovered eventually.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What on Terra is going on here?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Everyone, shut up.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Listen.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The sound is apurr-oaching!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: They're going to catch up with us!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No... that sound is...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Coming from within the cave.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Infected creatures!
